scenarios.name: SP2-NA-01 N/A justification with structural keyword passes

steps.text: an N/A slot with na_justification containing the word <keyword>
the structural N/A quality check is run
the slot passes the structural check

scenarios.name: SP2-NA-02 N/A justification without structural keyword is flagged

steps.text: an N/A slot with na_justification this control action has no hazardous context
the structural N/A quality check is run
the slot is flagged for missing structural keyword

scenarios.name: SP2-NA-03 N/A justification with no duration keyword passes

steps.text: an N/A slot with na_justification the action has no duration component
the structural N/A quality check is run
the slot passes the structural check

scenarios.name: SP2-NA-04 ratio monitoring flags responsibility above 75 percent N/A

steps.text: a responsibility RESP-1 with 4 total slots where 4 slots are N/A
the N/A ratio check is run with threshold 0.75
a flag is raised for RESP-1

scenarios.name: SP2-NA-05 ratio monitoring does not flag responsibility at exactly 75 percent

steps.text: a responsibility RESP-1 with 4 total slots where 3 slots are N/A
the N/A ratio check is run with threshold 0.75
no flag is raised for RESP-1

scenarios.name: SP2-NA-06 ratio monitoring does not flag responsibility below 75 percent

steps.text: a responsibility RESP-1 with 8 total slots where 2 slots are N/A
the N/A ratio check is run with threshold 0.75
no flag is raised for RESP-1

scenarios.name: SP2-NA-07 ratio monitoring only counts responsibility slots not coordination link slots

steps.text: a responsibility RESP-1 with 4 total slots where 4 slots are N/A
a coordination link CL-1 with 4 total slots where 4 slots are N/A
the N/A ratio check is run with threshold 0.75
a flag is raised for RESP-1
no flag is raised for CL-1

scenarios.name: SP2-NA-08 ratio monitoring produces a descriptive flag message

steps.text: a responsibility RESP-1 with 8 total slots where 7 slots are N/A
the N/A ratio check is run with threshold 0.75
the flag message contains RESP-1
the flag message contains the N/A count
the flag message contains the threshold percentage

scenarios.name: SP2-NA-09 structural check and ratio monitoring make no LLM calls

steps.text: a responsibility RESP-1 with 4 total slots where 3 slots are N/A with structural keywords
the structural N/A quality check is run
the N/A ratio check is run with threshold 0.75
no LLM calls are made
a responsibility RESP-1 with 4 total slots where 4 slots are N/A
a responsibility RESP-2 with 4 total slots where 1 slot is N/A
the N/A ratio check is run with threshold 0.75
a flag is raised for RESP-1
no flag is raised for RESP-2

scenarios.name: SP2-NA-11 empty slot list produces no flags

steps.text: no slots
the N/A ratio check is run with threshold 0.75
no flags are raised

background.text: the SP2 N/A quality module is importable
